name: unity-driver
summary: Run the Unity editor unattended from the shell: compile check, run an editor method, run tests, with errors pulled out of the log.
adapt: Add Logs/ to .gitignore if it is not there already (Unity's own template ignores it).
For `test`: the project needs com.unity.test-framework in Packages/manifest.json and at least one test assembly.

verified.how: In a new built-in-pipeline project: compile passed, and failed with the error line when a broken script was added; exec passed arguments through, reported a thrown exception, a custom exit code and a missing method; EditMode tests reported 2 passed, then 1 failed by name; compile was refused while another editor held the project. Not run: PlayMode tests, Windows, Linux.
